poaps-design-web3-communities.sourceDescription:
Design of badges for POAP inc. during 2020 and 2021.

What is a POAP?

POAPs are digital mementos, minted in celebration of life's remarkable moments. These badges are Non Fungible Tokens ( NFT ).

Each POAP is a gift from an issuer to collectors, in celebration of a special shared memory. By minting these memories to the blockchain, collectors build a rich tapestry of tokenized experiences which unlock a world of possibilities.
